name: howto
title: Claim the AI Pro months without paying later
sub: Do these in the first week, inside the return window
footer: From Google's Pixel help page, Samsung's offer terms and Prof H Lab, read Nov 18, 2026. Menu names change with updates.

items.head: Read the footnote
items.body: Check the redeem-by date on the maker's page. The Pixel 10 Pro banner outlived its Oct 31 deadline.

items.head: Check your Google One plan
items.body: Third-party billing, add-ons or a family plan you do not manage can block the offer.

items.head: Activate, then redeem
items.body: Open the Google One or Gemini app on the new phone and look for the offer.

items.head: Set a reminder
items.body: A card is required; the trial renews at $19.99 a month unless you cancel.

items.head: Cancel early if unsure
items.body: Google says access continues to the end of the trial after you cancel.

items.head: Keep the phone
items.body: Returning the phone may cancel the subscription; decide inside the window.
